αἶψ: αἶψα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (αἶψ’ = αἶψα)
αὐτόν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’himself’, or reinforcing a pronoun of any person (με … καὶ αὐτόν ’me myself as well’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’ as direct object of a verb: ἤλασε δ’ αὐτόν ’struck him’ · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, as subject of an infinitive: αὐτόν τε ζώειν ’that he live’
βάλ: βάλλω — throw, strike; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, elided (βάλ’ = ἔβαλε): ’struck’
βάλλειν: βάλλω — throw, put, cast; pres. inf., standing as an instruction (’throw (your hands) about’)
δίφρου: δίφρος — stool, seat; masc. gen. sg.
δεξιὸν: δεξιός — right, on the right hand; masc. acc. sg.
διαπρὸ: διαπρό — right through, clean through; adv. (διά + πρό)
δουρικλειτὸς: δουρικλειτός — famed for the spear; masc. nom. sg., epithet of Menelaus
δουρικλυτὸς: δουρικλυτός — famed for the spear (δόρυ + κλυτός); masc. nom. sg., epithet
θάρσος: θάρσος — courage, boldness; neut. acc. sg.
θέσφατα: θέσφατος — declared by a god; neut. acc. pl. as noun: ’things a god has declared, prophecies’
θῦνε: θύνω — rush, dart; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔθυνε)
κέκαστο: καίνυμαι — excel, surpass (+ dat.); plpf. 3 sg. with reduplication, impf. force: ’had excelled, excelled’
καθεῖσεν: καθίζω — set, seat, station (causative); aor. act. 3 sg.
καλύψας: καλύπτω — cover, hide; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having covered’
κρατός: κάρη — head; gen. sg. κρατός, from the by-form κράς; with κατά + gen.: ’down from the head’
μίμνον: μίμνω (= μένω) — stay, remain; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔμενον)
μακρῷ: μακρός — long, tall; masc./neut. dat. sg.
μεσσηγύς: μεσσηγύς — in between, midway; adv., epic (= Attic μεταξύ)
μετείη: μέτειμι — be among, have a share in; pres. opt. 3 sg., + dat., in a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’that he might be among’
οἰμώξας: οἰμώζω — wail, groan aloud; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having groaned’
οἷ: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl. οἷα, elided (οἷ’) · also orthotone dat. sg. of the 3rd-person pronoun (= οἱ): ’to him, to her’
πέπον: πέπων — ripe, soft; in address a familiar ’good (friend)’, exact sense uncertain; masc. voc. sg.
πέσε: πίπτω — fall; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεσε)
πεζός: πεζός — on foot, going by land; masc. nom. sg.
πονέοντο: πονέομαι — toil, labour, be busy; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted (Attic ἐπονοῦντο), unaugmented
πρηνής: πρηνής — headlong, face down; masc. nom. sg.
πύκα: πύκα — closely, snugly, firmly; adv. (πύκα ποιητοῖο ’closely built’)
σάωσε: σαόω — save, keep safe; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, epic (= Attic ἔσωσε, from σῴζω)
στυγερὸς: στυγερός — hateful, dread; adj., masc. nom. sg.
τίετο: τίω — honour, esteem; impf. 3 sg. pass., unaugmented (= ἐτίετο): ’was honoured’
τρέφει: τρέφω — nourish, rear, foster; pres. 3 sg. (of Amphitrite fostering sea-creatures) · also of food, ’nourishes, makes thrive’ (τά θ’ ὕεσσι τρέφει τεθαλυῖαν ἀλοιφήν ’which nourishes thriving fat on pigs’) · also of the earth, ’rears, nourishes’ (γαῖα τρέφει ’the earth nourishes’)
τυδεΐδεω: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus (patronymic of Diomedes); masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
τυδεΐδης: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. nom. sg. (patronymic)
τυχὼν: τυγχάνω — hit upon, obtain, + gen.; aor. part. act., masc. nom. sg.: ’having obtained’ · also aor. part., absolute, of a blow: ’having hit’ (the mark)
φίλοισι: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); masc. dat. pl.
χαριζομένη: χαρίζομαι — do a favour, be free with, give freely of (+ gen.); pres. part. fem. nom. sg.
ψυχρὸν: ψυχρός — cold; neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ
ἀΐξας: ἀΐσσω — dart, rush; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’darting’
ἀκάματον: ἀκάματος — untiring, unwearied; neut. acc. sg., of fire: ’unflagging’
ἀκαχήμενος: ἀχέω (ἀκαχίζω) — distress, grieve; perf. mid. part. masc. nom. sg., epic reduplicated: ’grieved, distressed’
ἀκωκή: ἀκωκή — point, edge; fem. nom. sg.
ἀμφεκάλυψε: ἀμφικαλύπτω — enclose, cover round, shelter; aor. 3 sg. (ἀμφί + καλύπτω): ’sheltered, enclosed’
ἀναχωρήσας: ἀναχωρέω — go back, draw back, withdraw; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
ἀπόρουσε: ἀπορούω — spring away, leap off; aor. 3 sg.: ’sprang away’
ἀφ: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., elided and aspirated before a rough breathing (ἀφ’ = ἀπό)
ἀφνειὸς: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; masc. nom. sg.
ἂμ: ἀνά (shortened and assimilated ἂμ before π) — up, along, among; prep. + dat.: ’along, among’ · also + acc., ’along, across, over’ (motion): ἂμ πεδίον ’over the plain’, ἂμ πέλαγος ’over the open sea’
ἄγρια: ἄγριος — wild, savage; neut. nom. pl.
ἄροιτο: ἄρνυμαι — win, gain, earn; aor. 2 opt. 3 sg. mid. (ἀρέσθαι) ’might win’
ἄρτεμις: Ἄρτεμις — Artemis, goddess of the hunt and of sudden painless death (esp. of women); fem. nom. sg.
ἐλθόντ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. masc. acc. sg., elided (ἐλθόντ’ = ἐλθόντα): ’at his coming’
ἐνήρατο: ἐναίρω — slay, kill; aor. 3 sg. mid., with active sense
ἐναλίγκιον: ἐναλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the speaker: ’like (a beggar)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the object ἄνακτα: ’like (a beggar)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the relative ὅν (subject of εἶναι), + dat.: ’like (the gods)’ (θεοῖς ἐναλίγκιον) · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with φᾶρος ’robe’, + dat.: ’like (the sun)’ (ἠελίῳ ἐναλίγκιον)
ἐριβώλακος: ἐριβώλαξ — rich-soiled, with big clods; adj. (2-term.), fem. gen. sg., with ἠπείροιο
ἐτέτυκτο: τεύχω — make, contrive, bring about; pass. come to pass, happen; plup. pass. 3 sg. with impf. sense: ’had been wrought, had come about’
ἐτεόν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly, really’ (εἰ ἐτεόν γε ’if indeed truly’)
ἑταίροισιν: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= -οις)
ἔκβαλε: ἐκβάλλω — cast out, throw out, let slip (a word); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέβαλε) · also of trees, ’fell, cut down’
ἔκλιναν: κλίνω — lean, prop; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they leaned’
ἔκφυγε: ἐκφεύγω — flee out, escape; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐξέφυγε)
ἔλασσε: ἐλαύνω — drive; aor. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, unaugmented (= ἤλασε); τεῖχος ἔλασσε ’drove (a wall), i.e. built’
ἔξοχα: ἔξοχος — outstanding, preeminent; neut. pl. used as adv.: ’above all, outstandingly’
ἔπεφνε: φένω (aor. ἔπεφνον) — slay; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist
ἔπτατο: πέτομαι — fly; aor. 3 sg. mid., epic (= Attic ἐπτάτο): ’flew’
ἔτρεφε: τρέφω — rear, nurse, bring up; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented
ἕ: οὗ, οἷ, ἕ — he, she, it (3rd-person pron.); acc. sg., subject of an infinitive: ’him’
ἕθεν: ἕ, οὗ — of himself, him, her; 3 sg. pron. (reflexive), gen. sg., epic ἕθεν (= Attic οὗ), after ἆσσον ’nearer’: ’to himself’ · also gen. sg. with εἵνεκα, ’of her’: ἕθεν εἵνεκα ’for her sake’
ἕρκεα: ἕρκος — fence, enclosure, courtyard; neut. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἕρκη) · also neut. acc. pl.: καθ’ ἕρκεα ’through the courtyards’
ἤλυθ: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. 3 sg., elided (ἤλυθ’ = ἤλυθε), epic (= Attic ἦλθε)
ἰδομενῆος: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, Cretan leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ἰοχέαιρα: ἰοχέαιρα — arrow-shooting (epithet of Artemis); fem. nom. sg.
ἱρεὺς: ἱερεύς — priest; masc. nom. sg., epic ἱρεύς (= Attic ἱερεύς)
ἴσχει: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, restrain (intensive of ἔχω); pres. 3 sg.
ἶσα: ἴσος — equal; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’equally’
ὀξυόεντι: ὀξυόεις — sharp, pointed; neut. dat. sg., epic -όεντι, agreeing with ἔγχεϊ
ὀρέξῃ: ὀρέγω — reach out, hold out, offer; aor. subj. 3 sg., after αἴ κέν: ’should hold out’
ὄμβρος: ὄμβρος — rain, rainstorm; masc. nom. sg.
ὄρσο: ὄρνυμι — rouse, stir; aor. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic (= ὄρσεο): ’rise up!’
ὄχεσφιν: ὄχος — chariot; masc./neut. dat.-instr. pl., old case-suffix -φι(ν) (= Attic ὄχοις)
ὑπέκφυγε: ὑπεκφεύγω — flee out from under, escape; 2nd aor. 3 sg. act.
ὕλη: ὕλη — wood, woodland, forest; fem. nom. sg.
ὠκὺ: ὠκύς — swift, quick; neut. acc. sg.
